SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SA0' AND period = 'M13' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2015', '2024') ORDER BY year
Which stable materials in the Materials Project have the widest band gaps?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(band_gap AS double) AS band_gap_ev FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE try_cast(energy_above_hull AS double) = 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the earliest patent in the library with "airplane" in its title?
SELECT patent_id, patent_title, patent_date FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE lower(patent_title) LIKE '%airplane%' ORDER BY patent_date LIMIT 5
What weather was most common in deadly crashes in 2022?
SELECT weathername, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in the blood–brain barrier set are known to cross into the brain?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_bbbp WHERE p_np = 1
Which kinds of federal lawsuits appear most often in the docket archive?
SELECT nature_of_suit, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE nature_of_suit IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average weekly wage for private-sector workers in Brooklyn in the first quarter of 2024?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT avg_wkly_wage FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '36047' AND cast(own_code AS varchar) = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND cast(qtr AS varchar) = '1'
Which U.S. patents have been cited most often by later patents?

SELECT p.patent_title, c.citation_patent_id, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_us_patent_citation c JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_patent p ON p.patent_id = c.citation_patent_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many final rules were published each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(issue_date, 2, 4) AS year, count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_regulations.federal_register_documents WHERE doc_type = '"RULE"' AND substr(issue_date, 2, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which NIH institutes gave out the most grant money in fiscal year 2023?
SELECT ic_name, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How often does the Texas regulator confirm an insurance complaint?
SELECT finding_type, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_insurance_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states recorded the most births in 2024?
SELECT stname, try_cast(births2024 AS double) AS births FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '40' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What share of PubChem substances were taken from patents through PATENTSCOPE?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN c1 = 'PATENTSCOPE (WIPO)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_substance_sid_map
Which medical specialties write the most Medicare prescriptions for insulin glargine?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_type, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE gnrc_name LIKE 'Insulin Glargine%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many reactions come from patent applications published in 2015?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_applications WHERE year = '2015'
Which federal assistance programs paid out the most in fiscal year 2023?

SELECT cfda_title, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many contract opportunities did the Department of Veterans Affairs post for work in New York in 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS notices FROM govblock_awards.sam_opportunities WHERE departmentindagency LIKE 'VETERANS AFFAIRS%' AND popstate = 'NY' AND posteddate LIKE '2025%'
Which offices appeared on the most ballots in North Carolina in 2020?

SELECT office, count(DISTINCT precinct) AS precincts FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'NORTH CAROLINA' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many brand-new public schools opened for the 2023-24 school year?
SELECT count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE sy_status_text = 'New' AND school_year = '2023-2024'
